scope: signed landscape sample for 3x3..19x19, separate research preview, not completed beauty/gameplay ranking
selection: one cross-size spine (17 matrices) plus one distinct 19x19 symmetric scientific witness
frequency_definition: For each distinct height count cells; exact_equal if spread=0; near_equal if spread<=1, else unequal; measure does not claim spatial uniformity.
scientific_limits: Exact local V=0 and full 4x4 block U=0 do not imply global U=0; M19-02C proved equal/nearly equal four-palette [-2,-1,1,2] impossible for N=8,12,16,19 under all local V0 and no equal orthogonal neighbors; 19x19 M19-02D witnesses therefore frequency-unbalanced.

records.notes: 4 знаковых веса в почти равных количествах; U ≠0 при V=0
